artifacts.title: Private recipe notebook
artifacts.content: I am keeping this as my own recipe notebook: small-batch breads and winter soups from my kitchen. I want to carve a simple linocut beside each recipe, but the recipes and drawings are mine for now.

artifacts.title: Bread and margin drawings
artifacts.content: Reworked the rye loaf measurements after two more tries. The notebook still feels like a record of what I cook at home. Added a linocut of the old oven in the margin.

artifacts.title: One supper annotation test
artifacts.content: Four friends cooked at one table tonight. I tried recipe cards where guests could mark a substitution in pencil. This was one evening to see whether the cards were readable; the notebook remains my personal collection.

artifacts.title: Shared card prototype
artifacts.content: Made one prototype recipe card pairing my soup recipe and linocut with a friend's note about adding beans. It is a private draft to test the layout, not a collected or published book.

artifacts.title: Seasonal table collection proposal
artifacts.content: I would like to invite people from the supper group to contribute one seasonal recipe each for a small Ember Table collection. This is only a proposal; I have not gathered recipes or assembled an issue. I hope the linocut drawings can sit beside each recipe.

artifacts.title: First Ember Table booklet shared
artifacts.content: Finished and shared the first Ember Table seasonal recipe booklet with twelve supper-group cooks credited as contributors. Their recipes and substitutions sit alongside my original linocut illustrations. This is the first completed group booklet.
